tb21.basis: CPUs: c30 big-model fit 2.2 + 0.166/slot at 80%; RAM 4 GB/slot (c30 big-model TB workers near 100 GB RSS on 16 slots); #378

tb21_slow.basis: Slow-served models (campaign launcher: model worker_profile = 'slow'; gate: a prior TB2.1 run of the model had tool share env_sec/(env_sec+model_sec) <= 0.25). #531 A/B 11-19 on sb2-0p33b (TB2.1 c30 items x3, seed-paired, concurrent, one server), 6 vs 10 CPUs at 32 slots: pass +2.4 pp [-1.6, +6.4]; tool time per model request +7% [-11%, +30%] (geometric mean by task, not significant), attempt wall time ~+6%; 0 infra/memcap; capped in 44% vs 22% of busy minutes; worker unit-h -40% per worker-hour (~-36% net). A tested operating point at 32 slots that accepts some CPU delay, not a fit: the uncapped arm used 7.4 cores in busy minutes, like the tb21 fit. RAM 2x the measured 32 GB peak (fill makes it 96 at no cost). Fast models keep tb21

cpu_model.source: #531 A/B operating point at 32 slots (6 CPUs); not valid at other slot counts
